_comment: Committed baseline for the regression gate. Compared against by scripts/check_regression.py.
These are MEASURED numbers from a real backtest against data/golden/pvf_valves.yaml, not
targets. Editing them to make a failing gate pass is the one change that defeats the whole
mechanism, so rebaselining goes through `scripts/check_regression.py --update`, which refuses
to lower a metric unless --accept-regression is also passed.
`arm` must stay `axiom`. The `no-evidence-contract` arm is the ablation control group and is
deliberately worse; baselining against it would invert the gate.
